feeds.title: Xtremehorticulture of the Desert
feeds.description: A blog by Robert Ll. Morris. Robert educates and consults with people on desert horticulture. His academic background in horticulture spans 40 years in arid and desert climates as well as 12 years in tropical horticulture.
